{%- assign gc = site.data.golf_caddie -%}
# {{ gc.name }}

> {{ gc.short_name }} is a minimalist golf scorecard app for iPhone and Apple Watch. It has no account, no GPS, and no subscription. You score each hole with a tap, with Siri, or from the Lock Screen. The core app is free with unlimited rounds; {{ gc.short_name }} Pro is a one-time ${{ gc.pricing.pro_price }} purchase.

{{ gc.short_name }} is made by an independent developer, {{ gc.developer }}. It is built for casual golfers who want fast, simple scoring without GPS rangefinders, swing analysis, or social feeds. It is a lightweight alternative to full-featured golf apps such as Arccos, Golfshot, and 18Birdies.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS {{ gc.min_ios }} or later) and Apple Watch
- App Store ID: {{ gc.app_id }}
- Category: {{ gc.category }}
- Price: Free download with unlimited rounds
- {{ gc.short_name }} Pro: one-time ${{ gc.pricing.pro_price }} in-app purchase, no subscription ({{ gc.pricing.price_note }})
- Free trial: {{ gc.pricing.trial_days }} days of Pro, no credit card required
- No account or sign-up. No GPS and no course database, so it works on any course, even without signal
- Data: rounds are stored in the user's own iCloud account. The developer collects no personal data, analytics, or crash reports
